gripOrHq.title: Running Interference
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Sneak Preview
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

gripOrHq.title: Invisibility
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Swiss Bank Account
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may use the following abilities whenever you pay any cost or penalty. [T]: Gain [2]. [3], [T]: Gain [6]. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Finders Keepers
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

ice.title: Reinforced Wall
ice.rulesText:

[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Experimental AI
root.rulesText: You may advance Experimental AI before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Experimental AI, trash one program for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

root.title: Antiquated Interface Routines
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has +1 strength.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.
